description: Installation of one externally illuminated projecting sign to premises
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission
Condition : 3 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Site Location Plan, 1075/04A, 1075/05A, 1075/06A, 1075/07A, Lighting Statement, 849/01, 849/02, 849/03, 849/04, 849/05, 849/06 Received on 28 April 2020 and Engineer Lighting Report Received on 29 June 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
